results.title: EHRI-UK Regional Placements
results.eligibility_notes: Open to UK-based undergraduate and postgraduate students across the humanities; 150 hours of project work at museums/archives/charities on the history of Nazi oppression / the Holocaust and refugees; honorarium on completion. 2026 call ended; 2027 call opens next March.
results.notes: Adjacent/explore fit: archive + heritage + social impact. Watch for the March 2027 opening. 2027 dates TBD.

results.title: Roy Porter Prize 2026/2027 (Student Essay Prize)
results.organization: Society for the Social History of Medicine (SSHM)
results.eligibility_notes: Undergraduate or postgraduate students; £500 + plenary at biennial conference + publishing mentoring. Requires SSHM membership (cheap, join via OUP). 5000-9000 words, social history of medicine.
results.notes: Entry form available from autumn 2026. Strong current-opportunity fit for a history undergrad.

results.title: History Essay Prize 2026-27
results.organization: Foundation for the History of Totalitarianism
results.eligibility_notes: Terms reference 'students' but do not explicitly restrict to undergraduates; open to student entrants. 1800-2000 words. Prize amount not stated on the page.
results.notes: AI-detection screening; entries by 12:00 noon UK time, 24 Jan 2027.

results.title: Britain and the World 2027 (#BATW2027)
results.organization: Britain and the World Conference / Society
results.eligibility_notes: CfP open to all career stages; conference explicitly does not discriminate between graduate students, independent scholars and established academics — undergrads may present 20-min papers. 250-300 word abstract. Newcastle, 30 Jun-2 Jul 2027.
results.notes: Best-paper prize with conditional journal publication in Britain and World (Edinburgh UP).

results.title: Leeds International Medieval Congress 2027
results.organization: International Medieval Congress, University of Leeds
results.eligibility_notes: Papers welcomed from any discipline; students may present 15-20 min papers (in-person or hybrid). Multiple strands with varying CfP deadlines.
results.notes: One strand ('England and Scotland') due 30 Sep 2026; another ('Dynastic Communities') CfP closed 21 Aug 2026. Conference 5-8 Jul 2027.

results.title: MAMO 2027 (Middle Ages in the Modern World)
results.eligibility_notes: Open call for papers/panels/workshops on medievalism; undergraduates may propose. Lincoln College Oxford, 22-24 June 2027.
results.notes: Abstracts c.250 words by 30 Sep 2026; relevant if interested in medieval history / reception.

results.title: Classical Association Conference 2027
results.eligibility_notes: Open to academics, students, teachers, ECRs and enthusiasts; papers / lightning talks / workshops. Notre Dame London, 9-11 Apr 2027. Themes include Roman Britain and classical reception.
results.notes: Submission deadline 25 Sep 2026; relevant for a classics-adjacent history student.

results.title: Historical Association Student Membership
results.eligibility_notes: Undergraduate history students; from £32/year; podcasts, articles, 'How To' guides, careers resources, free/discounted events and member webinars. Join any time.
results.notes: Explore/networking entry; low-risk, always open; demonstrates subject commitment on a CV.
